lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gill region, arranged in roughly horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a lattice pattern where the blobs serve as anchor nodes for the vertical-horizontal grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal aspect and localized shadowing on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance pixel clusters consistent with commensal organisms (remoras) attached to the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
